NATURALLY CURIOUS

Plant Your Flag

There was a time when the internet felt like wandering into someone's world.

You’d stumble onto a website at two in the morning and end up staying far longer than you planned, organically. There were no algorithms monetizing your attention. No pressure to perform. No engagement hacks designed to keep you contained. Just people creating little corners of the internet that felt unmistakably their own, places you could visit, bookmark, and return to.

Those places made the word “homepage” feel literal.

Somewhere along the way...

I don't want to build on borrowed land anymore.

I'm planting my flag.

NoelClark.com has been my home on the internet since 2010. It has always been my open journal, the place where I write without a distinct awareness of who is reading. No likes are counted. No views are documented.

It’s just me and my open journal... words from my heart, between me and you.

One day I'm writing about grief, faith, love.

The next I'm watching a young buck I've come to quite fancy stand perfectly still in my garden.

Then it's Thelonious Monk. Hip Hop history. The goldfinches that pleasantly surprised me and the hummingbird that joined them (lovely). A farmers market jaunt. A song that reminds me of a book I read. A thrift-store treasure hunt. The mathematics of nature. Tupac and faith (not Evans). The quiet miracle of a seemingly ordinary Tuesday afternoon and the Otis Redding or Nipsey Hussle song that provides its perfect soundtrack.

Life doesn't stay inside neat little categories.

Neither do I.

This is a place for people who enjoy wandering.

Who love following wild, unexpected connections.

Who believe that being naturally curious is a way of seeing the world.

Who would rather leave a conversation with a new perspective than another hot take.

If something you read here stirs something in you, write to me.

Tell me the only one piece of advice you want to be remembered for. Tell me what you're studying. Tell me about the moment a song changed your life, the book you can't stop recommending, the scent that still feels like one of your favorite memories, the person you're missing, the recipe everyone asks you to make, or the thought that hasn't left your side.

Nothing is too random.
Because nothing is random.

Some letters I'll answer privately. Others may become part of this ongoing journal because the best ideas have always been passed back and forth.

That’s the kind of place I want NoelClark.com to remain.

A place to let a thought marinate instead of immediately cycling through to the next highlight. To create art without performing art. To leave behind something imperfectly personal.

A place where the only filters are the ones you use to search through years of curiosity, memory, and vulnerability. A place for soul > ego.

So welcome. Stay awhile. Wander wherever your curiosity leads you.

And if you’ve been looking for a place that feels a little more connected, I hope you’ll plant your flag here, too.
